definition: Your AI Slop Bores Me (stylized in all lowercase and abbreviated as YASBM) is a website and social experiment created by programmer Mihir Maroju.
details: Serving as a parody of large language models (LLMs) like ChatGPT and Claude, all questions and image prompts posed by users are answered by other, randomly-selected human users of the site. As of March 2026, the site had reached 50 million hits and sustained approximately 16,000 concurrent users.
